name: Registry CLI smoke
command:
set -euo pipefail
command -v cg-registry
cg-registry --help >/dev/null
cg-registry agent list --json >/dev/null
cg-registry agent show system-architect --json >/dev/null
cg-registry skill list --json >/dev/null
cg-registry skill show architecture-hexagonal --json >/dev/null
cg-registry skill graph architecture-hexagonal --json >/dev/null
cg-registry capability list --json >/dev/null
cg-registry capability show architecture.dependency-analysis --json >/dev/null
cg-registry capability resolve architecture.dependency-analysis --json >/dev/null

name: Domain coverage gate
command:
cargo llvm-cov clean --workspace
cargo llvm-cov -p gateway-domain --all-targets --fail-under-lines 95 --json --output-path "$EVIDENCE_DIR/domain-coverage.json"

name: Declarative CLI smoke
command:
set -euo pipefail
cli="$RUNNER_TEMP/cg/bin/cg"
fixture=tests/fixtures/declarative-cli
"$cli" --help
"$cli" assess --context "$fixture/context.json" --json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/assessment.json"
"$cli" plan --context "$RUNNER_TEMP/assessment.json" --intent "$fixture/intent.json" --catalog "$fixture/catalog" --rules "$fixture/rules.json" --json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json"
"$cli" resolve --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json" --catalog "$fixture/catalog" --rules "$fixture/rules.json" --process "$fixture/process.json" --json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/resolution.json"
"$cli" explain --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json" --catalog "$fixture/catalog" --rules "$fixture/rules.json" --process "$fixture/process.json" --policy "$fixture/policy.json" --json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/explanation.json"
"$cli" compile --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.json" --catalog "$fixture/catalog" --rules "$fixture/rules.json" --process "$fixture/process.json" --policy "$fixture/policy.json" --projection "$fixture/projection.json" --json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/compiled.json"

name: CG-12 external project acceptance and CLI replay
command:
set -euo pipefail
export CG12_EXPORT_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/cg12-proof"
cargo test -p gateway-daemon --test declarative_cli cg12::
cli="$RUNNER_TEMP/cg/bin/cg"
cd "$CG12_EXPORT_DIR"
mkdir replay
"$cli" assess --context external-context.json --json > replay/assessment.json
"$cli" plan --context replay/assessment.json --intent external-intent.json --catalog . --rules rules.json --json > replay/plan.json
"$cli" resolve --plan replay/plan.json --catalog . --rules rules.json --process process.json --json > replay/resolution.json
"$cli" explain --plan replay/plan.json --catalog . --rules rules.json --process process.json --policy policy.json --json > replay/explanation.json
for step in step-condition.0.0 step-condition.0.1; do
  "$cli" compile --plan replay/plan.json --catalog . --rules rules.json --process process.json --policy policy.json --projection "projection-$step.json" --json > "replay/compiled-$step.json"
done
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import json
from pathlib import Path
artifacts = list(Path("replay").glob("*.json"))
assert len(artifacts) == 6
for replay in artifacts:
    assert json.loads(replay.read_text()) == json.loads(Path(replay.name).read_text()), replay.name
PYTHON

command:
